faq: Is this support available every hour of the day?
No. Response targets apply on business days and are written into your agreement. We do not promise round the clock cover. Anything outside those hours is answered when the next window opens.
What counts as an urgent problem?
Anything that blocks sales or damages the store, such as a broken checkout, a missing page, a stuck payment or a theme that stops loading. We confirm what counts when we start.
What if the fault is with my host or platform?
We find the cause, collect the evidence and help you raise it with the right support team. We cannot repair servers that we do not control, but we can speed the process.
What happens after the order window?
You get a plan for ongoing support and a quote that suits your store. Without a continuing plan, we simply return to normal order-based work.

desc:
Priority support for urgent store problems gives you a direct line to people who already know your setup. Ecom Swift LLC agrees response targets in writing, notes your key details and fixes urgent faults in your own store.

## What is priority support for a store?

Priority support is a short-term arrangement in which your urgent store problems move to the front of our queue. We set up a direct channel, record the essential facts about your store, and agree how quickly we will reply. When something breaks, you do not start by explaining the whole store to a stranger.

## Why urgent problems need a plan

Store emergencies tend to arrive at bad moments: during a sale, after an update or when a campaign has just started. Panic makes them harder. You may not know who runs your hosting, which app controls the cart or where the domain is registered, and each minute spent searching is a minute of lost orders.

A plan removes that scramble. When the facts are already written down and a helper is ready, the first hour is spent on diagnosis instead of hunting for logins and contacts.

## How faster response helps the business

Speed of response limits the length of a problem. A broken checkout fixed in the same day costs far less than one that lingers for a week. A fast reply also gives you information, even when the fix is not ours to make: you learn quickly whether the fault is in your theme, an app, your host or the platform.

There is a calmer benefit too. Knowing who to call, and roughly when they will answer, lets you keep running the business instead of watching the store.

## What good priority support includes

- A direct channel, such as email or a messaging app, set up for urgent issues.
- Response targets written down and agreed with you.
- A handover note listing your platform, theme, key apps, domain and hosting.
- A contact list for your host, platform and main app vendors.
- A short health check at the start, in the larger packages.
- Clear rules for what counts as urgent.
- A written summary after each issue, with cause and fix.
- Advice on preventing a repeat.
- An honest statement of what we cannot fix ourselves.
- A plan for what happens when the order window ends.

## What we do

At the start, we collect the facts we will need in an emergency and write them into a handover note stored for your account. We agree what counts as urgent, such as a store that is down, a checkout that fails or a page that exposes private data, and how you should contact us.

During the order window, when you report an urgent issue, we respond within the agreed target, investigate and fix what lives in your own store. If the cause sits with your host or platform, we say so straight away and tell you what to ask them, with the details they will need. After each issue we send a short written summary. Basic covers one urgent issue. Standard allows more, with a store health check and a faster reply target. Premium runs for a full week with the fastest targets, incident notes and a view on ongoing support, which is quoted separately. Priority support is not round-the-clock cover unless we state it in writing.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Report problems through the agreed channel so nothing gets lost.
- Include a link, a screenshot and the time the problem began.
- Tell us about recent changes, such as updates, new apps or edits.
- Keep your host and domain contact details current.
- Mark real emergencies as urgent and keep minor requests separate.

**Avoid:**
- Waiting until the evening to report something that began in the morning.
- Changing settings yourself while we investigate.
- Sending the same message through several channels.
- Calling every request urgent, since that weakens the priority.
- Assuming we can fix faults inside your host or platform.

## Who this is for

This suits a seller with a big launch or sale coming who wants support ready. It suits a store that has had a recent scare and wants a safety net for a few weeks. It also suits a small team without an in-house developer.

## What we need from you

Your store address, the platform and host you use, and access for us as a collaborator, staff or developer user. We never ask for passwords. Please name the people who can authorize urgent work.
